title: Daily pharmacy internship credit limit
rule_summary: A pharmacy intern may receive no more than 12 hours of pharmacy internship credit in one day.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply intern hours requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing intern hours with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
